title: Bundle Backport
description: A data pack that adds the new bundle crafting recipe to previous versions of the game
body:
# Bundle Backport

Free and open-source datapack for Minecraft 1.21 and 1.21.1 that introduice the new bundle crafting recipe which was added in snapshot 24w33a for the Bundles of Bravery 1.21.2 update

## Features

Adds the recipe of the bundle with leather and string instead of rabbit hide and string
